question: Identify the three specific items categorized as 'Built-in' in the menu displayed while the person positioned in the frame to the left of the hanging stringed instrument discusses personas to examine the server list shown by the individual positioned in front of the shelving unit containing numerous flat squares near the paneled door to determine the name of the server appearing directly to the right of 'Elasticsearch'.
gloss: What three items are listed under Built-in in that menu?
answer_a:
The video focuses on the integration of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers within the VS Code environment to expand the capabilities of AI-assisted coding. The discussion highlights how these servers allow large language models to interact with the external world by fetching data or performing actions like repository commits and pull requests.

In the first segment, while explaining customization features like instructions and prompts, a menu is shown in the chat view. This menu lists three 'Built-in' modes: Ask, Agent, as well as Edit. These modes represent the primary interfaces for user-AI interaction, with the Agent mode specializing in multi-step task execution using specialized tools.

In the second segment, the registry of MCP servers is displayed as a centralized marketplace for developers to discover tools. In the interface shown during the scroll, the 'Stripe' server is positioned horizontally to the right of the 'Elasticsearch' server in the top row of the grid. These various servers, which can be easily installed into first-party platforms like VS Code, provide the specialized domain expertise utilized by the previously mentioned chat modes.
